common_suffix: Follow the attached floor-plan crop for layout; use the brochure images only for materials and colours. No people, no text, no watermark, no logo. Do not add windows, doors or openings not described.

pantry.prompt_summary: SHORT compact walk-in pantry 1.70 m wide x 2.45 m deep (depth ~1.4x width, not a corridor); camera at the show-kitchen end looking in; far end open doorway to working kitchen; LEFT long wall ONE continuous counter run, light recon veneer base, pale stone-look top, plain wall above (no shelves, no wall cabinets, no sink); RIGHT wall plain, no window; no return counter; restrained service finishes per p17.

powder.prompt_summary: NARROW powder room 1.70 x 3.65 m; camera east end looking west; ALL fixtures on the LEFT (south) wall in one line: walnut veneer double vanity with TWO basins, bronze taps, mirror; then a short full-height partition projecting from the left wall with a wall-hung WC mounted on the left wall behind it; far west end wall holds only the entrance door (no WC on end wall); right wall plain; no window; p24 concrete-look porcelain, one Calacatta panel behind vanity. (r2a: same brief, rejected: WC read as end-wall mounted.)

office-gym.prompt_summary: Office 4.60 x 3.40 m at 1.5 m eye height (not elevated); camera at south looking north to full-height glazing onto the courtyard water feature; long walnut table running N-S; EXACTLY FOUR chairs: three on the LEFT (west) side, ONE on the RIGHT opposite the middle chair, none at ends; left wall walnut veneer panelling with door near camera (SW); right wall greige. (r2a rejected: 3+2 chairs.)

bath.prompt_summary: Shallow bathroom 2.90 x 1.70 m; camera against the north wall looking at the long south wall; ALL THREE fixtures in ONE row on that wall, left to right: walk-in shower with clear glass screen, floating walnut vanity with one basin and mirror, wall-hung WC; nothing on side walls; no window; p24 terrazzo/concrete-look porcelain, one Calacatta panel behind vanity.

living-dining.prompt_summary: Living/dining 12.40 x 5.10 m; camera on the south (kitchen) side looking north at the long rear wall; rear wall floor-to-ceiling glazing across almost its full width, slim bronze mullions, broken by ONE narrow solid section right of centre; end walls solid greige, no glass, no walnut panelling; dining table left with 10 chairs (4+4+1+1), L-sofa centre-right with square Calacatta coffee table, two lounge chairs and round side table at right. (r2a rejected: glazing wrapped onto right end wall.)

show-kitchen.prompt_summary: Show kitchen 5.70 x 2.70 m; camera on the living (north) side looking south; Calacatta-topped walnut island with induction hob and exactly THREE stools on near side; one straight LOW back counter on the south wall with sink and Calacatta backsplash; NO tall cabinets, NO full-height cupboards, NO wall cabinets, NO windows. (r2a rejected: tall units at right edge and a window at left.)

laundry.prompt_summary: Laundry 2.20 x 1.80 m; camera at north looking south; two front-loading appliances side by side on the south wall under one plain worktop; closed light-veneer storage beside; NO sink, NO basin, NO tap; no window; restrained service finishes.

kitchen-storage.prompt_summary: Tiny K. store 2.20 m deep x 1.40 m wide; camera in the west doorway looking east; small hand-wash basin with stainless tap in the far LEFT (NE) corner; ONE run of white open shelving on the RIGHT (south) wall only; left and far walls plain; no window. (r2a rejected: room read ~3.5 m deep.)

multipurpose.prompt_summary: Completely EMPTY multipurpose room 4.60 x 3.90 m, finishes only; camera near SW corner looking NE; wood-look door on the left (west) wall toward the NW corner; floor-to-ceiling glazing on the right (east) wall; no furniture, rug, art, plants or decor; beige porcelain floor, greige textured walls, black linear lights.
